nodes.description: PoolStorage.State _state holding staged/claimable/bonded/phantom balances and per-account state
_state.provider.univ2 UNI-V2 LP token used as the deposit asset of Pool
ERC20 private mapping _balances of account balances
ERC20 private nested mapping _allowances of owner/spender allowances
ERC20 private _totalSupply
Permittable.EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR used to build permit digests
Permittable nonces mapping(address=>uint256) incremented on each permit
Oracle._reserve counter-asset reserve snapshot
Oracle._pair UniswapV2 pair used as price source
Oracle._cumulative last cumulative price snapshot
Oracle._timestamp last observed block timestamp from the pair
EIP1967 implementation storage slot written via assembly sstore in Upgradeable
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller identity
block.timestamp, miner/validator manipulable time source
tx.origin, external origin of the transaction
Pool.deposit(uint256) external onlyFrozen notPaused: pulls LP tokens then stages balance
Pool.withdraw(uint256) external onlyFrozen: transfers LP tokens out then decrements staged
Pool.claim(uint256) external onlyFrozen: transfers ETHC then decrements claimable
Pool.bond(uint256) external notPaused: converts staged balance to bonded and mints phantom
Pool.unbond(uint256) external: converts bonded balance back to staged/claimable
Pool.provide(uint256) external: adds ETHC/DAI liquidity and bonds resulting LP tokens
Pool.emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256) external onlyDao: sends arbitrary token to the DAO
Pool.balanceCheck() private invariant check on UNI-V2 balances
Oracle.capture() public onlyDao: reads and updates the Uniswap TWAP
Oracle.updatePrice() private: computes price ratio from cumulative values and elapsed time
Ethic.transferFrom override that skips allowance decrement when allowance is uint256(-1)
Permittable.permit(...) external: ecrecover based approval with nonce and deadline
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(address) internal: sets implementation slot then delegatecalls initialize()
Deployer1.initialize() initializer: deploys the Ethic token
Deployer2.initialize() initializer: deploys Oracle and calls setup()
Deployer3.initialize() initializer: deploys Pool bound to oracle().pair()
DeployerX.implement(address) external without access control, forwards to upgradeTo
ERC20._transfer internal: moves balances and emits Transfer
Liquidity.addLiquidity(uint256) internal: transfers ETHC and pulls DAI to mint LP tokens
PoolSetters.incrementBalanceOfStaged(address,uint256) internal state mutation
PoolSetters.decrementBalanceOfBonded(address,uint256,string) internal state mutation
Getters.epochTimeWithStrategy using blockTimestamp() arithmetic
Setters.incrementBalanceOf(address,uint256) internal mint-like balance update
univ2().transferFrom external call on untrusted LP token contract inside deposit
ethic().transfer external ETHC transfer performed before claimable balance is decremented in claim
delegatecall to newImplementation initialize() in upgradeTo, executes arbitrary code in proxy storage context
ecrecover in permit; malleable signature / zero-address result handled by Require.that
assembly sstore writing the implementation slot in setImplementation
division by timeElapsed in updatePrice, zero when no time elapsed since last update
IERC20(token).transfer(address(dao()), value) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token address

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the depositing account whose staged balance is credited
_msgSender() is used as the spender in Ethic.transferFrom allowance handling
msg.sender is compared against dao() in the onlyDao guard of emergencyWithdraw
msg.sender is the DAI source of transferFrom inside addLiquidity called by provide
block.timestamp flows into epochTime arithmetic that drives epoch-based state transitions
block.timestamp determines elapsed time used to derive the oracle price
now is used in the deadline expiry check of permit
capture implicitly depends on the current block timestamp via Uniswap cumulative price accounting
deposit performs the external univ2().transferFrom call before staged balances are updated
claim performs the external ethic().transfer call before decrementing the claimable balance
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the new implementation
permit derives the signer via ecrecover over the digest
upgradeTo invokes setImplementation which writes the slot with assembly sstore
timeElapsed is used as a divisor in the price ratio computation
emergencyWithdraw makes an external transfer on a caller supplied token address
the external implement() function has no access control and reaches upgradeTo, allowing implementation replacement
unguarded implement() path leads to the delegatecall that executes arbitrary implementation code
bond mutates the Pool _state account and global balances
unbond mutates the Pool _state account and global balances
bond credits staged balance through incrementBalanceOfStaged
unbond debits bonded balance through decrementBalanceOfBonded

addLiquidity performs external ETHC transfer and DAI transferFrom calls
deposit pulls the univ2 LP token configured in _state.provider
the stored cumulative price snapshot is subtracted from the current cumulative value
the stored timestamp is subtracted from the current block timestamp
the oracle reserve snapshot is validated against the reserve minimum in updateOracle
EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is used to build the permit digest
nonces[owner]++ participates in the digest and is an unchecked increment
deposit value is credited to the caller staged balance
withdraw value is debited from the caller staged balance
claim value is debited from the caller claimable balance
the token address parameter selects the contract transferred out in emergencyWithdraw
the value parameter is the amount transferred in emergencyWithdraw
owner is the recovered signer and approval owner in permit
spender receives the allowance granted in permit
deadline bounds the validity window of the permit signature
newImplementation is stored as the proxy implementation and delegatecalled
amount is subtracted from the allowance in Ethic.transferFrom
bond value determines bonded and phantom increments
unbond value determines the staged/claimable/phantom deltas
provide value is the ETHC amount added as liquidity
newPhantom is the phantom amount minted during bond
newClaimable is credited to the caller during unbond
lessPhantom is debited from the caller phantom balance during unbond
digest is the hashed message fed into ecrecover inside permit
timeElapsed is computed and then used as the divisor of the price ratio
